question: Which of the following writers wrote the autobiography ‘Truth, Love and a Little Malice’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khushwant Singh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Khushwant Singh** wrote the autobiography 'Truth, Love and a Little Malice'.
 
• Khushwant Singh was a renowned Indian author, lawyer, diplomat, journalist, and politician.
 
• The autobiography provides a candid and witty account of his life, including his experiences, relationships, and views on various subjects.
 
• It is one of the most celebrated works of Khushwant Singh, reflecting his unique narrative style and insightful observations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Khushwant Singh was born on 2nd February 1915 and passed away on 20th March 2014.
 
• He is best known for his novel 'Train to Pakistan', which is a poignant tale set during the partition of India in 1947.
 
• Khushwant Singh was also the editor of several literary and news magazines, including 'The Illustrated Weekly of India' and 'The Hindustan Times'.
 
• His contributions to literature and journalism have left a lasting impact on Indian society and culture.
